methods.description: Require the pinned #908 roster and issue #1101 declared scope to each have 226 unique strings and equal exact membership before analysis; reject duplicate, missing and fabricated fixture cases.

Independently recompute each exact historical geoBoundaries subject to its recorded OCHA spatial-candidate P-code pair; make valid in memory, orient polygon exteriors CCW and holes CW, and sum positive WGS84 geodesic areas for polygon components. Compare all three scores to the archived values at 8 decimals.

conclusions.text: The old prose crosswalk hash is wrong; the immutable original crosswalk is 319025 bytes with SHA-256 28725b15d2f112f4cfbdc9390f39075164bb191ea91ca9904c63203b7b797fd3.
The original reproducer accepts a 227-entry roster containing a duplicate and emits byte-identical outputs; the pinned 226-ID roster itself is exact.
Orientation-safe recomputation matches all 678 original 8-decimal selected-pair scores; no selected input had a cancellation difference.
The current exact legal national ADM3 roster and complete georeferenced legal boundaries with verified reuse terms remain unresolved; the packet does not certify them.
